message: So, picture this: the lights go out, and I’m rummaging through drawers like a raccoon in a trash can, looking for candles. 😂 It’s funny until you realize, ‘Oops, I might be a little underprepared!’ That’s why I love this handy guide from the Red Cross on what to do during a power outage. It’s all about making sure that when the lights flicker, you’re ready to shine! What’s your go-to tip for staying calm during a blackout?
